idea-plugin.name: Sakura LSL
idea-plugin.description:
Sakura LSL

A one-stop IDE experience for Linden Scripting Language (LSL) developers using the Sakura toolchain: sakura-lslc (compiler), sakura-slemu (emulator), and sakura-lsltest (test runner).

  • File-type recognition and a friendly sakura icon for .lsl and .lslh files.
  • Hand-rolled lexer with keyword, builtin, constant, comment and string highlighting.
  • Smart completion of LSL built-in functions, constants and events, baked in as a static table.
  • Live error checking via an ExternalAnnotator that runs sakura-lslc in the background and surfaces gcc-style diagnostics inline.
  • Two run configuration types: LSL: run in slemu and LSL: lsltest run.
  • Hot reload to Second Life through the Firestorm external editor watch pattern: the plugin writes the saved script to a path Firestorm has been told to watch, and Firestorm reloads it in place. (SL has no public upload API, so an already-logged-in viewer is required.) A "copy script to clipboard" fallback is also provided.
  • Status-bar compile light: green / yellow / red — click to jump to the first diagnostic.

Configure Settings → Tools → Sakura LSL with the paths to lslc, slemu, lsltest, and your Firestorm external-editor watch directory.
